purpose: Control baseline: isolates the predictive power of strictly historical, account-level features alone (Phase 1 'Level 3.5 blocklist baseline'), to test whether apparent future graph-model gains are actually recovering this same account-level labeling structure rather than discovering new signal.

model.note: identical hyperparameters to scripts/train_xgboost.py, deliberately, so any performance gap is attributable to the feature set alone

feature_source: src/features/historical.py — strictly information_time < transaction_time; computed over the full chronological labeled dataset, verified via an independent leakage self-check (scripts/build_historical_features.py)
